clauses.requirement: Where other criteria are missing, the notation "systematic failures in use" for a type of retro-reflective material is established per paragraph 5 in Part 3 of Annex 4; the shape of the light emitting surfaces shall not be easily confused, from an observation distance of 10 metres, with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors in paragraph 2.1.

Shape and dimensions of the triangle: the retro-reflecting strip may be continuous or not; if not continuous, the free area of the supporting material shall be red (see also paragraph 5.9.4.2.1. of this Regulation).

Shape and dimensions of the triangle: for an advance warning triangle of type 1, the fluorescent surface shall be continuous to the retro-reflecting units and arranged symmetrically along the three sides of the triangle; in use its surface area shall be not less than 315 cm2; an edging, continuous or not, not more than 5 mm wide, not necessarily red, may be placed between the retro-reflecting surface and the fluorescent surface.
Shape and dimensions of the triangle: the side of the open centre of the triangle shall have a minimum length of 70 mm (Figure A5-VIII).
The shape and dimensions of the support of the advance warning triangle shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 8.2 of Annex 5 Part 3 (heading for the support provisions).
Shape and dimensions of the support: the distance between the supporting surface and the lower side of the advance warning triangle shall not exceed 300 mm.
The fluorescent retro-reflecting material shall be coloured in the mass, either in the retro-reflective elements or as a solid surface layer.
Environmental testing shall be carried out in accordance with Annex 6 of UN R150 (heading of the Annex covering environmental test requirements).
